subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Sullivan <james.sullivan@finservcorp.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Hi James / Priya —

Great to meet you both today. Thanks for taking the time to walk through the Redwood inference demo. Per our conversation, attached is a concise POC plan outlining scope, success criteria, timeline, and ownership so your evaluation team can move quickly. High-level recap: 

- Objective: Validate Redwood’s hosted inference performance and integration path for FinServCorp’s invoice-classification pipeline (latency and cost targets, plus quality checks).
- Core success criteria (proposed):
  • Avg token latency <= 150ms for 1–2 concurrent inference calls under a representative payload (150–300 tokens)
  • Classification precision >= 92% on the provided eval set
  • End-to-end throughput to support batch scoring of 10k documents/day with acceptable cost per document
- Timeline: 3-week POC (kickoff week + 2 weeks of evaluation), flexible to your calendar
- Ownership: Redwood (Marissa + Rishi) to provide deployment, baseline prompts, and run evals; FinServCorp (James + Priya) to provide data sample, evaluation labels, and access for integration testing

Attached: redwood-poc-outline-v1.xlsx (detailed milestones) and redwood-sow-draft.pdf (high-level SOW).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm the POC kickoff week (we have bandwidth the weeks of Nov 29 or Dec 6)
2) Share the representative dataset (anonymized) and the evaluation metric spreadsheet
3) Let me know any additional internal stakeholders to include in the kickoff invite

I’ll update the outline based on your notes and Rishi will stand up the evaluation harness once we confirm the kickoff date.

Thanks — looking forward to moving ahead.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
From: James Sullivan <james.sullivan@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finservcorp.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap and the docs. Quick questions from our side after syncing with the analytics team: 

- Can we extend the evaluation window to 3 weeks of data ingestion (so a 4-week POC total) to better capture throughput under weekend loads?
- For success criteria, can we add an operational metric: 99th percentile latency under sustained batch loads should be < 400ms?

We can share an anonymized sample dataset by EOD Wednesday. Our preferred kickoff would be the week of Dec 6 if that still works for you.

Also looping in Priya (product) who will coordinate internal test resources.

Thanks,
James
Director, Data Science — FinServCorp
james.sullivan@finservcorp.com | (212) 555-0102
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Sullivan <james.sullivan@finservcorp.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

James / Priya — perfect, thanks for the notes. We’re fine extending the evaluation to a 4-week window (kickoff + 3 full weeks) and adding the 99th percentile latency target to the operational success criteria. I’ve updated the POC outline with those two changes and attached the revised redwood-poc-outline-v1.xlsx. Key updates: 

- POC duration: Kickoff week + 3 evaluation weeks (total ~4 weeks)
- Success criteria (updated):
  • Avg token latency <= 150ms (typical load)
  • 99th percentile latency < 400ms under sustained batch loads
  • Classification precision >= 92% on provided eval set
  • Throughput target: support batch scoring of 10k documents/day with cost targets in spreadsheet
- Responsibilities:
  • Redwood: deploy test endpoint, provide baseline prompts, run automated evaluation harness weekly, produce interim report at end of week 2 and final report at end of week 4
  • FinServCorp: provide anonymized sample dataset, label set, access for integration testing, and a primary technical contact (Priya or alternate)
- Proposed kickoff: week of Dec 6 — suggest a 60-minute technical kickoff (agenda: scope, test dataset, credentials, evaluation cadence)

Rishi — can you take point on the evaluation harness and confirm we can deliver an interim report by end of week 2? Vivek — can you confirm we’ll need any additional infra config for the 99p latency target or if the default hosted profile is sufficient?

James — once you confirm the kickoff week I’ll send a calendar invite with the kickoff agenda and a shared Drive folder for test artifacts.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
From: James Sullivan <james.sullivan@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Thanks Marissa — that all looks good. We confirm the kickoff for the week of Dec 6; preferred slot is Tue Dec 7 10:00–11:00am ET. Priya will be the primary technical contact. We’ll share the anonymized dataset by Wednesday EOD and the label set by Friday.

One ask: we have a short security questionnaire (SOC2 / data handling) that we’ll need completed prior to ingesting any samples. Rishi, can you confirm who on your side should take that (and an estimated turnaround)?

James
